verdict.rationale: An AI-training opt-out or no-training data policy is a fair privacy question for a SaaS platform like Flagsmith, so the axis applies. The evidence pack contains no AI-training policy or opt-out control. Self-hosting gives "full control over your data", but that is an adjacent deployment option, not a documented guarantee about AI model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
